slides.title: How my AI editor *works.*
slides.lead: One clip in. A finished reel out. 7 steps.

items.sub: Whisper finds every word and its time
HDR phone video to normal video

slides.label: STEP 1
slides.title: Listen *first.*
slides.body: Whisper turns speech into words with timestamps. Every later step is built on those times.

slides.title: Cut only the *real* pauses.
slides.code:
<c>// 0.6s+ of silence is a pause</c>
<k>if</k> quiet_run >= <s>0.6</s>:
    cut(quiet_run, keep=<s>0.3</s>)

slides.label: STEP 7
slides.title: Measure, don't *trust.*
slides.body: Loudness, frame-by-frame glitch scan, safe zone. If it fails, it doesn't ship.

slides.title: Follow the *build.*
slides.lead: I'm building my own CapCut with AI.
